verdict.rationale: Spending controls are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only pay-as-you-go, usage-based billing and scale-to-zero cost savings. Nothing shows a hard spending cap, budget limit or billing alert. Usage-based pricing and idle cost savings are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
